intents.name: technologies
intents.answer: • *Leeway tech stack* (selected after requirement analysis): • *Frontend:* React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS • *Backend:* Node.js, Python (FastAPI / Django), Golang, Laravel, .NET Core • *AI & ML:* OpenAI (GPT APIs), LangChain, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI • *Mobile:* iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), React Native, Flutter • *Data:* PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Firebase, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redis • *Cloud & DevOps:* AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD • Ask which stack fits your product — tap *Get a Quote* or *Technologies* in the menu.

intents.name: projects
intents.answer: • *Portfolio & impact:* • 1500+ clients · 14 years · 120+ CPaaS projects · 60+ apps · 45+ AI solutions • *Trusted names:* Tata Tele, BHEL, Powergrid, Bandhan Bank, Club Mahindra, Airport Authority, Indian Railway, RITES, Jindal, Lodha, universities & education boards • *Industries:* Government & PSU, BFSI, Education, Hospitality, Enterprise, Politics, Retail & e-commerce • *Highlight:* MoU with Government of Gujarat for AI (pathway for 250+ jobs) • Detailed case studies shared on request with client permission — ask for a walkthrough.

intents.name: careers
intents.answer: 💼 *Careers at Leeway Softech* • We're hiring across sales, product, design, QA, support and operations. • *Sample openings:* Sales Executive (2–4 yrs, Mumbai/Bhavnagar), BDM (2–5 yrs, Mumbai), QA Tester (1–2 yrs, Bhavnagar), UI/UX Designer (1–2 yrs, Bhavnagar), L1/L2 Support (2–4 yrs, Delhi), Senior HR/Accountant/IT Manager as posted. • Apply: https://leewaysoftech.com/careers — PDF resume max 2 MB, or email HR with the role in the subject. • Culture: Life @ Leeway — festivals, anniversaries, trips and team events.

intents.name: benefits
intents.answer: • *Why teams choose Leeway Softech:* • *Certified security & quality* — ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001:2013, CMMI Level 3 • *Proven at scale* — 1,500+ clients across India • *Government-grade trust* — MoU with Government of Gujarat for AI • *True end-to-end* — CPaaS, software, AI and cloud under one partner • Dedicated POC, transparent delivery, NDA/IP-friendly contracts, post-go-live support • Offices: Mumbai (corporate), Bhavnagar (registered), Delhi/NCR, Ahmedabad
examples: why should we work with you

intents.name: service-enquiry
intents.answer:
• Here's what Leeway Softech offers:
• *Generative AI Development* — LLM apps, agents, private RAG, evaluation & guardrails (₹1.5 Lakh - 8 Lakh / Project)
• *AI Chatbot Development* — Flows, FAQ/KB, handoff, analytics, multilingual options (₹75,000 - 3.5 Lakh)
• *Machine Learning Solutions* — Predictive models, NLP, ranking, model ops handoff (₹2 Lakh - 10 Lakh)
• *Computer Vision Solutions* — Detection, OCR, quality inspection, dashboards (₹2 Lakh - 8 Lakh)

• *Enterprise Software Development* — Custom enterprise apps, workflows, SSO, audit trails (₹3 Lakh - 25 Lakh)

• *Web Application Development* — Responsive portals, APIs, admin consoles, SEO basics (₹1 Lakh - 10 Lakh)
• Ask for details on any item, or tap *Get a Quote* / *Request a Callback*.
